lines.en: Mia, did you read the news this morning? It is thought that the river has been polluted for several months.
lines.pt: Mia, você leu as notícias hoje de manhã? Acredita-se que o rio esteja poluído há vários meses.

lines.en: I did. It is said that a factory upstream is responsible, but nobody has been charged yet. Isn’t that strange?
lines.pt: Li. Dizem que uma fábrica rio acima é responsável, mas ninguém foi acusado ainda. Não é estranho?

lines.en: Very. The lake is believed to have been clean ten years ago, and now fishing has been banned along the whole bank.
lines.pt: Muito. Acredita-se que o lago estava limpo há dez anos, e agora a pesca foi proibida em toda a margem.

lines.en: I saw dead fish near the bridge last week. They are thought to have been poisoned by chemicals.
lines.pt: Vi peixes mortos perto da ponte na semana passada. Acredita-se que tenham sido envenenados por produtos químicos.

lines.en: That is awful. The water has been tested twice, and the results have been sent to the environmental agency.
lines.pt: Isso é terrível. A água foi testada duas vezes, e os resultados foram enviados à agência ambiental.

lines.en: Let’s hope they act quickly. The factory is known to have ignored warnings in the past, as the report says.
lines.pt: Vamos torcer para agirem rápido. Sabe-se que a fábrica ignorou avisos no passado, segundo o relatório.

lines.en: And local residents are said to be furious. A protest has been planned for Saturday outside the town hall.
lines.pt: E os moradores locais estão furiosos, segundo dizem. Um protesto foi marcado para sábado em frente à prefeitura.

lines.en: I would like to join. I have been told that the organisers need volunteers to hand out leaflets.
lines.pt: Eu gostaria de participar. Disseram-me que os organizadores precisam de voluntários para distribuir folhetos.

lines.en: Then come with me. My sister has been asked to speak, and she is thought to be quite persuasive.
lines.pt: Então venha comigo. Minha irmã foi convidada a falar e dizem que ela é bastante persuasiva.

lines.en: Good. Meanwhile, shall we walk around the lake? The path has just been repaired, so it should be safe.
lines.pt: Ótimo. Enquanto isso, vamos caminhar ao redor do lago? O caminho acabou de ser consertado, então deve ser seguro.

lines.en: Sure. And bring a bag. If we see any rubbish, it can be collected before the weekend crowds arrive.
lines.pt: Claro. E leve uma sacola. Se virmos lixo, ele pode ser recolhido antes de a multidão do fim de semana chegar.

pages.title: Mito ou fato? · 1/2

items.s: It is thought that is a reporting structure.
Has been tested is a present perfect passive.
We say “It is thought that the river has polluted”.

pages.instruction: Decida e explique com suas palavras.

solo: Aluno responde e justifica; você mostra a pista.
group: Cada aluno decide sozinho, depois compare as respostas e peça uma justificativa.
Corrija pela pista do texto, não só dizendo “certo/errado”.
extra90: Peça que cada aluno invente uma pergunta igual para o colega.
answers: It is thought that is a reporting structure. → Verdadeiro (Yes.)
Has been tested is a present perfect passive. → Verdadeiro (Yes.)
We say “It is thought that the river has polluted”. → Falso (We say has been polluted.)

pages.title: News about the river · 1/3
paragraphs: It is a cloudy afternoon in Brisbane. Flo and Noah arrive at the lake. A heron stands near the bank. Noah holds a newspaper in his hand. The water looks darker than usual. Flo wants to talk about the news.

“Noah, did you read the news this morning? It is thought that the river has been polluted for several months.” says Flo. “I did. It is said that a factory upstream is responsible, but nobody has been charged yet. Isn’t that strange?” says Noah. “Very. The lake is believed to have been clean ten years ago, and now fishing has been banned along the whole bank.” says Flo.
